card.text: Box-shaped moon of Neptune, one of the darkest objects in the solar system.

introduction.text: Proteus is almost massive enough to have pulled itself round. Craters cover it, with no sign of later geologic change.

normal.title: Clear-filter mosaic
normal.summary: Brightness is corrected for lighting; much of the fine grain is image noise.

filter-color.title: Voyager false color
filter-color.summary: Voyager green, blue and violet filters in false color; broad patterns only.

elevation.title: Shape-derived radial height
elevation.summary: Height above or below a 208 km sphere; unseen terrain is modeled.
